title: The holidays don’t define you.
metaDescription: Embrace the restart in your routine without guilt. Find out how to get back on track with intention and confidence.
excerpt: Embrace the restart in your routine without guilt. Find out how to get back on track with intention and confidence.
author: Devon RD
bodyHtml:
What you did or didn’t do, what you ate or didn’t eat, doesn’t make you “good” or “bad” – it makes you human.
Eating off-plan or moving less than usual isn’t a failure. Success isn’t about perfection; it’s about how gently and confidently you return to your routines.

If getting back on track feels hard, take a moment this week to write down the habits that supported you before the holidays. Start there. Restart with intention, not guilt. You’ve done it before, and you can absolutely do it again.
